sections.voiceover: Did a massive spillover from Lake Bidahochi carve the Grand Canyon 6.6 million years ago?
Could a massive spillover from Lake Bidahochi really be the secret behind the Grand Canyon's formation?
A collaborative study by the U.S. Geological Survey confirms this spillover theory with new evidence.
Lead researcher John J. Y. He analyzed thousands of zircon crystals to prove this spillover theory. It happened 6.6 million years ago.
Check the latest Science journal to see how this 6.6 million-year-old mystery finally unfolds.
